messages:
maria (security): Auditor reached out asking for SOC2 evidence covering KMS/HSM key rotations, access logs, and chain-of-custody for keys used in the 2024-10-01 incident. They want exportable logs and repro steps. Can we assemble?

jamal (sre): Yep. I can pull rotation metadata + access logs. Need clarification: auditor wants raw HSM access events or redacted bundle?

ISO_Auditor: Raw events are fine but we expect redaction for customer PII. Chain-of-custody must show key import/export, rotation timestamps, and operator IDs.

alex (support): FYI the customer incident is INC-4829 — high latency then 500 errors around 2024-10-01 03:12 UTC. Logs might overlap with key rotation window. Attaching ticket link: https://tickets.redwood.com/INC-4829

sre_anshul: Starting export now. I'll run the CloudKMS/HSM extraction and produce:
- rotation-manifest.csv
- access-events.jsonl
- key-ops-audit.log

Command I use:
```
redwood-kms export --start 2024-09-30T22:00:00Z --end 2024-10-01T06:00:00Z --format jsonl --out /tmp/kms-export
```

jamal (sre): Note: HSM vendor only exposes operation IDs and operator principal; not raw key material. Confirmed no keys leave HSM. I'll annotate the bundle with a short README clarifying that.

maria (security): Good. Auditor also asked for retention policy and sampling proof that logs are retained for 2 years per control. Can legal/ops confirm policy doc link?

alex (support): Policy is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/log-retention#kms-hsm

ISO_Auditor: Also need hash of exported bundle and chain-of-custody signature. Please include SHA256 sum and an export.md describing who ran export and exact commands.

sre_anshul: Will do. Generating sha256:
```
sha256sum /tmp/kms-export.tar.gz > /tmp/kms-export.sha256
```
I'll upload to secure evidence bucket after redaction: https://storage.redwood.com/evidence/soc2/INC-4829/

maria (security): Timeline: auditor expects deliverables by EOD tomorrow. Jamal/Anshul — can you confirm?

jamal (sre): Yes, we can deliver by EOD tomorrow. Will DM about redaction decisions. :thumbsup:

auditor_bot: Checklist update: evidence_bundle_uploaded=false; sha256_provided=false; chain_of_custody_doc=false; deadline=2024-11-02T23:59:00Z

maria (security): Thanks team — keep thread updated with upload link and any blockers.
